Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer performed a search for "Philip of Sicily father" and found information indicating Philip of Sicily (1255/56–1277) was the son of King Charles I of Sicily and Countess Beatrice of Provence. However, this Philip was not the prominent figure; the correct father for the more well-known Philip I of Taranto was Charles II of Sicily. The WebSurfer's initial search didn't disambiguate between the two Philips, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
